## Setup
```{r init, message = FALSE}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

split.by = 'Patient'
cell_label <- "cell_type_formatted"

path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "qc_analysis")
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path, "type_integrated.rda"))
seurat <- subsampling_sc(seurat)
seurat <- subset(
    seurat_old, 
    subset = Type == "WT"
)
```

```{r}
types  <- unique(seurat$Patient) %>%
  str_remove_all("_?\\d+")

col_inds <- list(
  c("#FB9A99", "#E31A1C"),
  c("#B2DF8A", "#33A02C")
)
color_types <- sapply(col_inds, last)

col_inds <- list.mapv(unique(types), f(i, j) ~colorRampPalette(col_inds[[j]])(length(types[types == i]))) %>% as.character()
```

## UMAP
```{r}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    label = FALSE
)
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    split.by = split.by,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
p <- plot_feature(seurat, pt.size = .25, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mitochondrial", "percent_ribosomal")) %>%
        list.map(f(x, y, z) ~x + ggtitle(str_clean(z)))
plot_grid(plotlist = p, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, align = "hv")
```

```{r, message = FALSE}
plot_dim_cycle(seurat)
```

## Annotation
### Main cell types
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- cell_label
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cells.png"))

plot_dim(seurat)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    group.by = cell_label,
    split.by = cell_label,
    ncol = 3,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()
```

### B cells
```{r, message = FALSE}
b_cell <- subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == "B cell")
Idents(b_cell) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"

plot_dim(b_cell) + labs(title = "B cell", x = NULL)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    b_cell,
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 3
) +
    NoLegend()
```

### Cell subtypes
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_subcells.png"))

plot_dim(seurat)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    cols = palette_continuous(gray = FALSE)(unique(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted) %>% length())
)

cell_categories <- seurat$cell_type_formatted %>% unique() %>% na.omit()

list.map(
    cell_categories,
    f(x, y) ~ subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == x)
    ) %>%
list.map(
    f(x, y, z) ~
        plot_dim(
            x,
            group.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
            cols = rep(palette_discrete(), 5),
            pt.size = .25
        ) +
        labs(title = z, x = NULL) 
) %>% plot_grid(plotlist = ., align = "hv", nrow = 2)

cell_list <- map(cell_categories, ~ {
  seurat$cell_subtype[str_detect(seurat$cell_subtype, paste0("^", .x))] %>% na.omit() %>% keep_parenthesis()
}) %>%
  set_names(cell_categories)

p <- list.map(
  compact(cell_list),
  f(x, y, z) ~ plot_bar_sc(x, z)
)

plot_grid(plotlist = p, align = "hv", ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
```
